registered_before: Any spatial_v1 outer-fold result; first fold training was in progress when the second candidate was specified

candidates.name: spatial
candidates.change: Frozen native PixelSeal feature pyramid plus learned context head

candidates.name: synthetic
candidates.change: Same architecture, 820 fit-parent-only synthetic pretraining updates, then 120 real epochs with recomputed dihedral guidance

selection: Each candidate selects checkpoint and per-method threshold on its own inner tune splits. No outer-driven hyperparameter search, per-method cherry-picking or blend sweep.
promotion: Compare to Adobe initially; if spatial is accepted by the existing gate, synthetic must also beat spatial under the same gate before replacing it. All5foldgains>0, paired mean>=0.002, conditional99percentbootstraplower>0.
public_leaderboard: Submission receipt tracking only; never a criterion for adjusting the experiment.
limitations: Two planned candidates still create model-selection uncertainty. The510trainingimages have been reused for development; final hidden organizer data is the independent evaluation. No promise of zero overfitting or a near-perfect score.
